title: Bridge and Clock
author: T. M. Halloran
blurb: Odile Nystrom, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
